Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_AllowRemoteThroughLock: Allow remote to operate locked doors
If enabled, the remote will temporarily unlock the door group to toggle it, then restore the previous lock state.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_BatteryDrainToggle_too: Battery percent points consumed each time you use the remote to toggle a door.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_BatteryDrainWrongCode: Battery drain per wrong code (% points)
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_BatteryDrainWrongCode_: Battery percent points consumed when entering an incorrect keypad code (pairing mode).
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_EnableRadialMenu_toolt: Enable or disable the radial menu for garage door controls.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GarageHighlightColor_t: Color used for garage highlights in inventory hover, radial menus, and Garage Manager world highlighting.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GarageManagerEnabled_t: Enable the Garage Manager panel for naming garages, assigning codes, and saving coordinates. When disabled, the menu item and keybind are hidden.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateAllowRemoteThrough: Allow controller to operate locked gates
If enabled, the gate controller will temporarily unlock the gate group to toggle it, then restore the previous lock state.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateBatteryDrainLock: Gate: battery drain per lock/unlock (% points)
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateBatteryDrainLock_t: Battery percent points consumed each time you lock or unlock a gate with the controller.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateBatteryDrainPair: Gate: battery drain to pair/unpair (% points)
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateBatteryDrainPair_t: Battery percent points consumed when pairing or unpairing the gate controller.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateBatteryDrainToggle: Gate: battery drain per toggle (% points)
Battery percent points consumed each time you toggle a gate with the controller.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateGroupSearchRadius_: How far to search around the player when finding HydeCo gates to operate or pair with.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateHighlightColor_too: Color used for gate highlights in inventory hover, radial menus, and Gate Manager world highlighting.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateManagerEnabled_too: Enable the Gate Manager panel for naming gates and viewing entries. When disabled, the menu item and keybind are hidden.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateManagerMaxSlots_to: Maximum number of entries visible and stored in the Gate Manager UI. Entries beyond this are kept in ModData but will not appear in the Manager UI.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateOpsCondDecayThresh: Gate battery: ops threshold before decay
Number of gate movement operations in a day before additional battery condition wear is applied.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GateRemoteRange_toolti: How far the HydeCo Gate Controller can operate a paired gate.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_GroupSearchRadius_tool: How far to search around the player when finding garage doors to pair with.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_HackKeypadElectricityL: Minimum Electricity skill level required to unlock the Hack Keypad option (if you do not have the Hacking perk). Set to 0 to disable the skill requirement.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_HackKeypadHackingLevel: Minimum Hacking skill level (from Hacking Skill mod) required to unlock the Hack Keypad option. Ignored if the Hacking perk is not present. Set to 0 for no requirement.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_KeypadAttemptsShown_to: How many recent keypad attempts to display in the keypad window.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_KeypadHints_tooltip: Adds hint panels to the keypad: separate Bulls/Cows counters and a 4-slot reveal that fills with known correct digits as you discover them.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_KeypadLockoutBaseAttem: Size of each lockout stage (in wrong attempts). The chance is banded by this value: attempts 1-N = 0%, N+1-2N = 33%, 2N+1-3N = 66%, 3N+1+ = 99%. Example: N=10 -> 1-10:0%, 11-20:33%, 21-30:66%, 31+:99%.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_ManagerMaxSlots_toolti: Maximum number of entries visible and stored in the Garage Manager UI. Entries beyond this are kept in ModData but will not appear in the Manager UI.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_PairMaxDistance_toolti: Maximum distance from a garage door allowed when pairing the remote.
Sandbox_HydeCoAGD_RemoteRange_tooltip: How far the remote can operate a paired garage door. Higher values increase range.
